summary:
Comprehensive architectural plan to:
1. Strip all 11 category role pill switchers and their inline PIN prompts from TopBar, enforcing legitimate operator authentication via Logout and account-specific sign-in.
2. Fully replace legacy terracotta (#C4785A and variants) across all CSS tokens, components, and views with the official Atrium brand orange (#d4522f / #E8643F) and matching translucent washes.
3. Enhance the onboarding workstation for already signed-in users with a branded 'Return to Workspace' AtriumButton and a subtle 'Login with another account' switch action, while ensuring direct app entry on boot.
